description: Monorepo sync workflow: handoff, delivery, and record of Forge changes
deviation_notes: Created 2026-10-20 on the owner's request (2026-10-19: "We definitely need some 'sync changes to monorepo' workflow"). Gaps from the ghost release: manual handoff, no sync record in Forge, a byte-identical griffin rebuild that bumped mounts to 1.0.2, manual QC game choice, and no way to leave a feature commit out of a fix sync.
